AbusedTenant: I don’t see anyone following me, It’s too crowded here.
Little_Richard: No matter.
Little_Richard: Just go to the place I sent you coordinates for and don’t allow him to catch up to you.
AbusedTenant: Ok
Little_Richard: He won’t shoot you in a crowded place, too many witnesses.
Coordinates lead me to a place somewhere in a no-go zone.
Little_Richard: For now stop looking around for him and at your phone, it might make DAK wary. We only have one chance at this.
